restaurants.name: JinJu Patisserie
restaurants.summary: The acclaimed patisserie reopened in a new North Williams home (soft opening Oct. 21); Karen Brooks predicts its salt breads are destined for Portland cult status.

restaurants.name: Bar Siete
restaurants.summary: Oswaldo Bibiano's seventh restaurant and first full bar, in the former Shaku Bar space; WW singled out the $7 small bites, the borrego tatemado and a fiery huevo en diablado.

reviews.verdict: First look: one of Portland's foundational Mexican chefs

restaurants.name: Oscar Food & Wine
restaurants.summary: A tiny natural-wine spot in the former Kashiwagi sushi space with a fish-heavy menu that WW found transportive despite sitting next to a Plaid Pantry.

restaurants.name: OK Chicken & Khao Soi
restaurants.summary: Earl Ninsom (Eem, Yaowarat) took over the original Pok Pok space; Portland Monthly calls it easily the buzziest local opening of the year, with a flamethrower-hot som tum Lao.

reviews.verdict: Easily the buzziest local opening of the year

restaurants.name: Yui
restaurants.summary: Chef Chalunthorn "Yui" Schaeffer's Thai restaurant settled into a permanent SE Belmont home after years of pop-ups, and earned praise in Portland Monthly's roundup of new Thai spots.

reviews.verdict: Praised in a review of three new Thai restaurants

restaurants.name: Bangkok Belly
restaurants.summary: A small-menu Thai newcomer whose satay skewers Portland Monthly called the star of the show.
